forwarder_said: No reply to the request or to chaser 1 and chaser 2.
message_to_send: No message to the forwarder until the controller decides.
why: Trigger: no reply after the request and two chasers, 23 hours before departure (Escalation 2.1). The Cargo Capacity Controller must decide how to handle the booking; nothing is released on risk signals R1-R3 or history (Space 3.2, 3.4), and the booking stays unchanged (Escalation 3.2). Sources: booking B-03, forwarder F-05, message M-03, Space 3.4, Escalation 2.1, Escalation 3.2.
